description: Oxia Planum elevation samples from the NASA JPL Mars Trek elevation-profile service. Values interpolate the DEM named in 'dem'; 0.01 degree spacing does not add detail beyond that DEM.
request_template: ?path=[[lon_west,lat],[lon_east,lat]]&numberOfPoints=201&radiusInMeters=3390000 (one request per latitude row; duplicated start point dropped)
units: meters (as returned by the service; MOLA heights are relative to the Mars areoid)
coordinate_convention: planetocentric latitude; longitude listed both as display (-180..180) and east 0-360
layout: row-major, rows north to south (lat_axis order), columns west to east (lon_axis order)
